label: Paper Notebook
summary: Warm ruled-paper scenes for visible reasoning, derivations, and review checklists.
description: A portrait-first notebook grammar using a paper field, blue and graphite ink hierarchy, sparse red corrections, margin annotations, and deterministic marks without raster assets.
layoutGrammar: Treat the paper as a continuous field rather than a stack of cards.
Reserve red ink for correction, warnings, and intentionally open review gates.
Keep annotation notes in a fixed margin rail and preserve the ruled baseline.
Render every equation, note, and checklist state from typed fixture input.
Use CSS and DOM marks only; do not require raster paper or sticker assets.

sourcePolicy.notes: All copy, geometry, marks, and paper effects are original and local to the package.

notes: The dedicated family composition avoids shared integration edits.
The checklist edge fixture keeps one human approval gate intentionally open.
